Denny’s Happy Hour Deals: Satisfy Your Hunger for Less

When it comes to finding affordable dining options, Denny’s has long been a go-to choice for those looking for tasty meals at great prices. With its famous Denny’s Happy Hour deals, the restaurant makes it easier than ever to enjoy your favorite menu items without breaking the bank. This guide offers detailed insights into the deals you can find during Denny’s Happy Hour, covering everything from breakfast dishes to burgers, sides, and specials.

What is Denny’s Happy Hour?

Denny’s Happy Hour is a special time when many of the Denny’s menu items are offered at discounted prices, giving customers a chance to enjoy their favorite meals for less. This deal is available at various restaurant locations across the country, offering a range of menu items from breakfast to dinner.

Menu Items at Denny’s Happy Hour

When you sit down at Denny’s during Happy Hour, you’re greeted with a rich variety of menu items to choose from. Whether you’re in the mood for a burger, pancakes, or breakfast dishes such as the famous Grand Slam, there’s always something delicious waiting for you.

Denny’s Happy Hour Menu Items Price
Pancake Breakfast $4.99
Grand Slam $5.99
Classic Burger with Fries $6.99
Triple Cheese Threat Burger $7.99
Moons Over My Hammy Sandwich $5.99
French Toast Slam $6.49

Popular Breakfast Options During Happy Hour

If you’re a fan of breakfast, Denny’s Happy Hour has a selection of breakfast options that you’ll want to try. From their Slam breakfast dishes to the ever-popular pancakes served with a choice of sides, there is something for everyone.

The Grand Slam Breakfast

The Grand Slam is perhaps one of the most well-known dishes on Denny’s menu. During Happy Hour, this beloved breakfast dish is available at a reduced price, making it an even better value. For more about its variations, you can visit Denny’s Breakfast Menu.

Grand Slam Options Price
Traditional Grand Slam $5.99
All-American Slam $7.99
Lumberjack Slam $8.99

Pancake Specials

A stack of 8 buttermilk pancakes is a great way to start your day, and Denny’s serves it with premium vanilla ice cream, strawberry sauce, and a dusting of powdered sugar during Happy Hour.

Pancake Specials Price
Classic Buttermilk Pancakes $4.99
Double Berry Pancakes $5.99
Chocolate Chip Pancakes $5.49

 

Denny’s Burger Deals

Burgers at Denny’s are more than just a meal – they’re a satisfying experience. Happy Hour brings burger lovers some of the best deal options, featuring everything from classic brioche bun offerings to specialty grilled burgers.

Denny’s Happy Hour Burgers Price
Cheeseburger $6.99
Bacon Avocado Cheeseburger $7.99
Triple Cheese Threat Burger $7.99
Build Your Own Burger $8.49

The Triple Cheese Threat Burger

The Triple Cheese Threat is one of the standout burgers on the Happy Hour menu. Made with fried mozzarella sticks and three-quarter pound patties, this burger invokes a freakishly good flavor that is hard to resist.

Sides and Add-Ons to Complement Your Meal

No Denny’s Happy Hour meal is complete without adding a few sides. During Happy Hour, you can enjoy sides like french fries, wavy-cut fries, or even fried mozzarella sticks.

Happy Hour Sides Price
Wavy-Cut Fries $2.99
French Fries $2.49
Mozzarella Sticks (4 pcs) $3.99
Onion Rings $2.99

Wavy-Cut Fries

A classic side option, served with wavy-cut fries, is a perfect match for any burger. Crisp and golden, these fries are seasoned to perfection.

Sausage Links and Hash Browns

If you’re having breakfast, don’t miss out on the sausage links and hash browns. They pair well with any of Denny’s breakfast dishes, whether you’re ordering french toast or the Grand Slam.

Denny’s Famous Slams: More Than Just Breakfast

Beyond just breakfast, Denny’s Slams are a category all their own. From the Grand Slam to the Say It Three Times Slam, these options are hearty, filling, and always a good deal.

Denny’s Slam Specials Price
Grand Slam $5.99
Lumberjack Slam $8.99
French Toast Slam $6.49

Say It Three Times Slam

The Say It Three Times Slam is one of Denny’s newest additions. This Slam comes with scrambled eggs with cheddar cheese, two slices of artisan bread, cream cheese icing, and is topped with vanilla cream. It’s the kind of meal that will leave you wanting to order it again and again.

Desserts and Sweet Treats at Denny’s

For those with a sweet tooth, Denny’s Happy Hour offers a range of desserts that will satisfy your cravings.

Denny’s Dessert Specials Price
Premium Vanilla Ice Cream $3.49
Chocolate Lava Cake $4.99
Strawberry Pancake Puppies $3.99

Afterlife Menu

For fans of themed menus, the Afterlife Menu at Denny’s offers a spooky twist on classic dishes.

Denny’s Happy Hour for Kids

Denny’s Happy Hour isn’t just for adults. If you have little ones, you’ll be pleased to know that Denny’s offers a range of kid-friendly menu items during Happy Hour. These dishes are affordable, delicious, and perfect for growing appetites.

Denny’s Kids’ Specials Price
Kids’ Pancake Special $3.99
Kids’ Chicken Nuggets $4.49
Kids’ Mac and Cheese $3.99

Free Kids’ Meals

Some Denny’s locations offer free kids’ meals during certain hours, making it an even more attractive option for families looking to save money while dining out.

Denny’s Menu Prices: What to Expect

One of the reasons Denny’s continues to be a popular dining option is its commitment to offering meals at a reasonable price. You can expect to find menu items like burgers, pancakes, and Grand Slams at prices that are competitive and family-friendly. For the full pricing details, visit Denny’s Full Menu.

Denny’s Menu Prices Price
Pancake Breakfast $4.99
Classic Burger with Fries $6.99
Moons Over My Hammy $5.99
Grand Slam $5.99

The 5.99 Deal

During Happy Hour, some menu items are priced as low as 5.99, making it possible to enjoy a full meal at a fraction of the regular price.

If you love affordable meals, you’ll also enjoy our complete guide to the American Deli menu — discover delicious deals and popular items to try next.

Conclusion

Denny’s Happy Hour continues to offer some of the best deals in the restaurant world. Whether you’re looking for a hearty breakfast, a satisfying burger, or a sweet dessert, Denny’s has you covered with their extensive menu and affordable prices. To find a location near you, visit the Denny’s Store Locator.
